name: xquik-toolkit
description: Source-aware Xquik toolkit for Twitter/X advanced search, profiles, trends, SDKs, MCP, exports, monitoring, webhooks, and approval-gated account workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Current X data workflows through REST, SDKs, and remote MCP
interface.longDescription: Use current Xquik source contracts for Twitter/X advanced search, profile and trend reads, SDK integration, exports, monitoring, webhooks, private reads, and approval-gated account actions. The plugin auto-registers the first-party remote MCP server and keeps persistent, metered, media, and account operations behind an explicit confirmation gate.
defaultPrompt: Run a bounded Twitter advanced search with Xquik.
Choose the current Xquik SDK for this application.
Prepare a gated X monitoring and webhook workflow.
